description: TO_TIMESTAMP / TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ parsing: an explicit Snowflake format is honoured and a date-only format defaults to midnight. The unit rule for an epoch is the sharp part, both halves live-verified: a NUMERIC argument is ALWAYS seconds and is never magnitude-sniffed, so 1631711999000 reads as seconds and lands in year 53676 rather than as the millisecond epoch of 2021-09-15, while a STRING of digits DOES pick its unit by magnitude and the same 13 digits read as milliseconds. An explicit scale argument fixes the unit for the numeric form. Converted 1:1 from functions/ToTimestampParseTest (now retired); the Java compared java.time toString values, so the suite reads TO_VARCHAR, and the wide-year case is pinned by its year prefix as the Java pinned it.
